Own-residual check, reading EO 14070 in full (secs. 1-3): it revokes or amends no order, transfers no function, fund or property and creates no office or right (sec. 3(c)). Sec. 1 recites agency actions already taken under EO 14009 and statutes (Medicaid expansions, the 2021 Special Enrollment Period, proposed rules); those rest on the cited statutes and regulations, not on the order. Sec. 2 directs agencies to review their actions and examine listed policy areas; that duty ends with the order. EO 14148 sec. 2(uu) revokes EO 14070 and, in sec. 3(b), sets a review of actions taken under it, which is not a savings clause. S0 prefill (none_after_bounded_search) KEPT after reading both. research_rationale: EO 14070 (signed 2022-04-05, 87 FR 20689-20691), read in full from the held official FR text, recites agency actions under EO 14009 and the American Rescue Plan Act (sec. 1), directs agencies to review actions to expand health coverage (sec. 2) and has general provisions (sec. 3). It has no term or sunset; the dossier's fixed_term hits are a recital of a one-month Open Enrollment extension. EO 14148 sec. 2(uu) (reading record LSP-EO_14148) revokes it with no effective-date wording, effective on signing 2025-01-20. Dossier missing line 'target provision not located: EO:14009' read: EO 14009's held text (86 FR 7793) is not an amending or ending order for EO 14070, which postdates it and merely builds on it; ruled out. The OFR 'See: EO 14009' note on EO 14070 is a cross-reference. The inventory is the dossier's 24 contiguous clauses from sec. 1 to the signature line and is kept. No other held official text names EO 14070. Savings: none found.
